test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Hariharan was conferred the Padma Shri in 2004 for his contribution to which of the following fields?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Art - Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hariharan** is a renowned Indian playback singer and ghazal artist.
 
• He was conferred the **Padma Shri** award in **2004** for his outstanding contribution to the field of **Art - Music**.
 
• Hariharan is known for blending **Indian classical music** with contemporary styles, making him a unique figure in the music industry.
 
• He has performed in multiple **languages**, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Bengali.
 
• Hariharan is also credited for popularizing the genre of **ghazals** in India, earning him widespread recognition and acclaim.
 
• He is a recipient of several awards, including **Filmfare Awards** for his playback singing and contributions to Indian cinema.
 
• Hariharan is one of the pioneers of the **Indian fusion band Colonial Cousins**, which blends Indian and Western music, further highlighting his versatility.
 
• His works have significantly contributed to the enrichment of India's musical heritage and cultural identity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Medicine**__

 __
 
• **Medicine** is the science and practice of diagnosing, treating, and preventing diseases.
 
• It includes various disciplines such as **pathology, pharmacology, surgery, and public health.**
 
• India has made significant advancements in medicine with institutions like **AIIMS** and **ICMR**.
 
• This field involves healthcare professionals such as **doctors, nurses, and researchers.**
 
 
 
• **Sports**__
 __
 
• **Sports** encompass physical activities like cricket, hockey, football, and athletics aimed at improving physical fitness and competitive spirit.
 
• India has globally recognized sports personalities such as **Sachin Tendulkar, PV Sindhu, and Neeraj Chopra.**
 
• The government organizes events like the **Khelo India Youth Games** to promote sports at the grassroots level.
 
 
 
• **Civil Service**__
 
 
• **Civil Service** refers to administrative roles in the government, including positions like IAS, IPS, and IFS.
 
• Civil servants play a crucial role in implementing **policies, laws, and public administration.**
 
• The selection process involves exams conducted by the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).**
 
• India’s civil service system is one of the largest administrative structures in the world.
